sin.name: handed-out-collection
sin.description: a getter whose whole body returns the class's own `Collection`, untouched — a Collection is an object, so every caller holds the same one and may `push`, `forget` or `sort` it behind the class's back
sin.rule: A class keeps its own Collection: hand out something a caller cannot change, and give the class the methods callers were reaching in to use.
sin.suggestion: Return `$this->lines->collect()` or `$this->lines->all()` — a copy and a plain array, neither of which the caller can change on you — and add the methods the callers were doing by hand: `addLine()`, `totalFor()`, `without($line)`. A PHP array returned from a getter is already copied, which is why this is about a Collection and not about every getter.
